CLIPORA / FEATURE

A clipboard for images, too.

Keep a copied screenshot alongside the text and links from the same task. Find it again from a thumbnail, paste it into a compatible app or extract its words.

On this page
Copy an image while Clipora is runningPreview, paste or saveExtract words with offline Windows OCRKnow what is stored

Copy an image while Clipora is running

Copy a non-sensitive screenshot or image from an application that places PNG or bitmap data on the Windows clipboard. Clipora records supported images while running and unpaused. A copied file path is a file reference, not automatically an image capture.

Search the library or open quick access with Ctrl + Alt + V. Image thumbnails help distinguish entries without displaying repeated “Copied image” labels as the only clue.

Preview, paste or save

Select an image and paste into an app that accepts image data. A plain-text field cannot receive an image. Use the clip’s image action to save a supported image to a file when that fits your workflow better.

The website playground shows a synthetic thumbnail and inserts a clearly labeled text placeholder for its sample image. The native Windows app performs the actual image clipboard operation.

Extract words with offline Windows OCR

Use the image clip’s text-extraction action to run Windows OCR locally. A clear screenshot with large, high-contrast text generally gives a better result than a blurred or heavily compressed image.

Recognition depends on the image and the Windows OCR language support available on your PC. Check names, numbers and punctuation against the source before using the extracted text. This website does not upload images or offer a simulated OCR result.

Know what is stored

Clipora encrypts captured image data in its local library. Individual clipboard formats are bounded to 32 MiB. Extremely large or unsupported image formats may not be captured.

Recording an image does not transfer ownership of it. Only reuse images you have permission to use. Pause recording when handling private screenshots and review your retention and deletion controls.
